simple.meaning: מַשְׂרֵת (masrêth) is a Hebrew word meaning “a pan.” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: This word has limited occurrence data, so BibleIQ begins with the Hebrew word, its basic meaning, and the verse where it appears.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to מַשְׂרֵת (H4958) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: English translations can use the same English word for different Hebrew words. BibleIQ anchors the study in מַשְׂרֵת (H4958) before moving outward to related references.
simple.summary: מַשְׂרֵת (masrêth) / H4958 is traced through 2 Samuel 13:9 using source-language evidence and occurrence comparison.

definitions.full: H4958. masreth מַשְׂרֵת noun masculine apparently = pan, dish , Palestinian Aramaic מסרית , only הַמּ ׳וַתִּקּח 2Sam 13:9 and she took the pan ; perhaps = ֗֗֗ מַשְׂאֶרֶת , originally dough-pan ( שׂאר ), kneading-trough, Gei Urschr.382f We (not Dr); > Klo Bu Ry in Di Exod 12:34 (3te Aufl.) ( אֶתֿ ) הַמְּשָׁרֵת וִתִּקְרָא and she called the servant (HPS del. v.)
definitions.rootNote: apparently from an unused root meaning to perforate , i.e. hollow out ;

occurrences.englishText: She took the pan, and poured them out before him; but he refused to eat. Amnon said, “Have all men leave me.” Then every man went out from him.
